text.description_html:
Schlage F-Series, Bowery Door Knob Set With Modern Century Rose

Modernly designed with an even easier installation, this door knob and rose will not disappoint those looking for an contemporary way to improve the style of any home both on the interior and the exterior. Stylish, The Bowery Knob with the Century Rose is available in your favorite contemporary finishes. Made by Schlage, this knobset fits standard door cutouts and has an adjustable backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4". It is adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" door thicknesses. Available in dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

Features of the Schlage Bowery Door Knobs:

  • One piece knob for better security and appearance.
  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • ANSI A156.2 series 4000 grade 2 keyed entry function.
  • Pressure-cast zinc tubular lock housing.
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty on residential applications.
  • Solid brass knob and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the F-Series Bowery Schlage Door Knob Century Rose:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/10"
  • Rose Height: 4-5/32" (4.15")
  • Rose Width: 2-27/32" (2.84")
  • Adjustable Backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" thick doors
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" Round Corner (1/4" radius corners)
  • Housing Diameter: 7/8"
  • Throw: 1/2"
  • Strike Plate: 1-5/8" x 2-1/4" Round Corner Full Lip Strike Plate

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on one side of the door. It does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. The lock is activated by a push button in the center of the knob while turning the inside knob releases the lock. It can be opened from the outside with a small circular tool.
  • Keyed Entry (Keyed Lock): Use when a handle operated by a lock is needed. Unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside always unlocked.
